transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Um, I came in because... well, I'm having a really hard time with food. It's like, once I start eating, it feels like I just disappear and something else takes over. Even while I'm in my head telling myself to stop, I just keep going. I keep going until I literally can't stand it anymore, and I just can't seem to control it.
After these episodes of eating, do you engage in any behaviors to try to prevent weight gain, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

Yeah, I do. After I eat like that... I usually end up in a bathroom in my dorm, or sometimes I'll find a quiet floor in the library. I, um, I make myself throw up. I just get terrified that all that food is just sitting there in my stomach, turning into weight, so I feel like I have to get it out.
